div.head: II Cn 68.1b
div.ab: ⁊ þy we sceolon medmian ⁊ gesceadlice todælan ylde ⁊ geogoþe, welan ⁊ wædle, freot ⁊ þeowet, hæle ⁊ unhæle.
⁊ þi we sculon medemian ⁊ gescadelice todælan ylde ⁊ geogoðe, [welige ⁊ wædle, frige ⁊] ðeowa, hale ⁊ unhale.
And þy we scylon medmian ⁊ gescadelice todælan ylde ⁊ geogoðe, welan ⁊ wædle, freot ⁊ þeowæt, hæle ⁊ unhæle.
Unde mediare debemus et distincte discernere senium et iuuentutem, libertatem et seruitutem, felicem et infelicem (habundantiam et inopiam), sanitatem et infirmitatem.
Debemus itaque moderari, discrete distinguere senium et iuuentam, opes et inopiam, libertatem et seruitutem, egritudinem et sanitatem.
⁊ þi we sculon medemian ⁊ gescadelice todælan ylde ⁊ geogoðe, [welige ⁊ wædle, frige ⁊ þeowe], hale ⁊ unhale.
And þy we sceolon medmian and gesceadlice todælan ylde and geogoþe, welan and wædle, freot and þeowet, hæle and unhæle.

Und desshalb müssen wir ermässigen und verständig unterscheiden Alter und Jugend, Reichthum (Reiche B) und Armuth, Freiheit und Knechtschaft (Freie und Knechte B), Gesundheit und Krankheit (Gesunde und Kranke B).

And therefore we must moderate and sensibly distinguish age and youth, wealth (the rich, B) and poverty, freedom and slavery (free men and slaves, B), health and sickness (the healthy and the sick, B).
And therefore we must make due allowance and carefully distinguish between age and youth, wealth and poverty, freemen and slaves, the sound and the sick.
And therefore we must moderate and distinguish reasonably between age and youth, wealth and poverty, freedom and slavery, health and sickness.
And thus we must acknowledge and carefully distinguish between the old and the young, the rich and the poor, the free and the unfree, the well and the sick.
